in_hebrew.name: Pail
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Basin or container
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Pail הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Greek word 'pithos', meaning a large earthenware jar or basin. In the Bible, Pail is mentioned as a companion of Paul and is known for carrying goods for the early Christian community.
